title: Api telemetry series
description: The body of GET /api/telemetry/series (alias GET /api/series): the downsampled history the recorder seeds its charts from. The backend decimates — an analog tag keeps the minimum and the maximum of every bucket in time order so short excursions survive, a digital tag keeps its transitions — and never returns more than two thousand points per tag. `source` says whether the window came from the live ring or from the one-minute aggregates; `discontinuities` lists the instants where the client breaks its lines.

series_point.title: Series point
series_point.description: One charted value as a two-element tuple of the data time and the value; null is a break in the line. The WebSocket frame telemetry.series carries the same tuple.

series_entry.title: Series entry
series_entry.description: The downsampled history of one tag over the requested window.

kind.description: Whether the tag is an analog measurement or a digital state.

unit.description: Unit of the values, as the signal registry declares it; the empty string for a digital state.

points.description: The points in ascending time order, at most two thousand of them.

from.description: Start of the returned window in data time.

to.description: End of the returned window in data time.

source.description: Where the points came from: the live sample ring, or the one-minute aggregates for a window older than the ring.

series.description: One entry per requested tag, in the order the request named them.

discontinuities.description: Every instant inside the window where data time jumped, in ascending order.
